# References {.unnumbered}

Each chapter lists the works it cites at the foot of its own page. This is the
combined list, and it prints only works actually cited somewhere in the book, so
an entry here means some chapter rests on it. The bibliography source is
`references.bib` in the book repository.

Many entries were carried over unchanged from the bibliographies of the two
causal econometrics guides, keeping the same citation keys, so a passage can move
between the three books without a key being renamed.

The conjoint-analysis chapter is pinned to a frozen build, because `radiant` cannot
be installed on the current R, and a frozen chapter does not register its citations
with this list. Its two works are @hainmueller-2014 and @kuhfeld-1994.

::: {#refs}
